metaDescription: Cultivation is a Minecraft 1.21.1 Fabric mod that makes farming a practice instead of a chore: living soil that tires and recovers, a polyculture growth bonus, dietary variety, meal buffs, and a 3×3 scythe.
ogDescription: An agriculture overhaul for Minecraft 1.21.1 Fabric. Living soil, crop rotation, dietary variety, meal buffs, high-tier hoes, Fertilizer, and the Scythe.

hero.sub: Cultivation makes farming a practice instead of a chore — soil that lives and tires, fields worth planning, food worth varying. Everything grows from vanilla crops and vanilla blocks.

sections.title: In Development
sections.lede: Cultivation is fully designed and specced — implementation is underway. Nothing is released yet; everything below describes the design.

items.title: Living Soil
html: Every farmland block carries its own fertility — draining under harvest, halved by rotation, recovering over three days of fallow. Tired soil turns visibly pale and cracked.

items.title: A Varied Table
html: Eating the same food again and again dulls it, down to half effect. Three different foods reset the fatigue — and the crafted stews finally repay the bowl with 2-minute buffs.

items.title: Invested Farmland
html: Diamond and netherite hoes till farmland with a permanent bonus-drop chance, and the composter produces Fertilizer — one dose, +1 yield on every harvest, forever.

items.title: The Scythe
html: Iron, diamond, and netherite. One swing harvests and replants a full 3×3 — large-scale manual farming as rhythm instead of tedium.

blocks.html: Also in the design: a 20% polyculture growth bonus for alternating-row fields, and villager farmers that rotate crops and rest tired ground. Read the full promise in design/VISION.md.

sections.title: Part of Concord
sections.lede: Cultivation is a member of Concord — a modular collection of system overhauls. Install any, combine all: every mod stands entirely on its own, and siblings light up together without ever being required.
